title: Analysis of the integration of oncological patients with surgical consultation or treatment needs into palliative care
summary: To identify existing barriers in the palliative care referral of oncological patients receiving concurrent surgical treatment, qualitative data are required regarding surgeons’ perspectives on palliative care integration processes. To this end, surgeons from various hospitals will be interviewed in focus group settings to elicit their opinions and experiences concerning communication pathways and decision-making processes.

interventions.name: Surgeons from visceral surgical departments in Germany will be interviewed once in focus groups regarding their experiences with the palliative care referral of oncological patients.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Senior consultants, specialist physicians, and resident physicians from the 4th year of training onwards in the field of visceral surgery.
Exclusion criteria:
none
